program: Biomedical Life Sciences PhD - Systems Biology track (Department of Systems Biology; Vagelos Institute's Biomedical Research Education)

requirements.quote: All students in the Systems Biology Specialization come with strong training in a related field such as biology, computer science, mathematics, physics, or chemistry, and an interest in conducting research as part of a multidisciplinary team.

problems: No specific math coursework is named. Mathematics is only one of several alternative 'related fields'. The listed formal requirements on the same page are a Bachelor's degree in a scientific or engineering subject, letters, personal statement, and interview (GRE not required).
The program FAQ https://systemsbiology.columbia.edu/frequently-asked-questions sets no fixed minimum scores and no coursework prerequisites.

Umbrella pages checked (Vagelos/VIBRE Biomedical Life Sciences page, Systems Biology track page, how-to-apply, prospective-student FAQ): no math prerequisites. The track page says VIBRE PhD candidates must demonstrate proficiency in coding and statistics during the PhD; that is a degree competency, not an admission prerequisite.
